import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

if(!flowFile) return

    def inputText = IOUtils.toString(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
    def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(inputText)

    def timestamp = json.timestamp
    def updateAge = json.update_age

    def outputList = []

    json.each { key, value ->

        if(key != "timestamp" && key != "update_age" && value instanceof List){

            def record = [
                timestamp : timestamp as Long,
                key : key,

                latitude : value.size() > 4 ? value[4] : null,
                longitude : value.size() > 5 ? value[5] : null,

                heading : value.size() > 8 ? value[8] : null,
                roc : value.size() > 9 ? value[9] : null,
                aircraft_type_status : value.size() > 10 ? value[10] : null,
                message_source_flags : value.size() > 11 ? value[11] : null,
                update_age : updateAge
            ]

            outputList.add(record)
        }
    }

    def outputJson = JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson(outputList))
    outputStream.write(outputJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))

} as StreamCallback)

import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

try {
    flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { inputStream, outputStream ->

        def json = new JsonSlurper().parse(inputStream)

        def timestamp = json.timestamp ?: null
        def outputList = []

        json.each { key, value ->

            if (key == "timestamp" || key == "update_age") return

            def modeSHex = key
            def data = value as List

            long modeSId = Long.parseLong(modeSHex, 16)

            def row = [
                id             : null,
                live_plot_id   : null,
                track_id       : null,
                time           : timestamp ? new Date(timestamp as long).toInstant().toString() : null,
                time_ist       : null,
                latitude       : data[4],
                longitude      : data[5],
                speed          : data[7] as Integer,
                heading        : data[8] as Integer,
                flight_level   : data[6] as Integer,
                roc            : data[9] as Integer,
                ssr            : data[3]?.toString(),
                mode_s_id      : modeSId,
                flight_status  : null,
                is_vehicle     : false,
                ac_type        : null,
                callsign       : data[0]?.trim(),
                registration   : null,
                flight_id      : null,
                ad             : null,
                flightnumber   : null,
                att            : null,
                ett            : null,
                stt            : null,
                ott            : null,
                runway         : null,
                distance       : null,
                created_date   : new Date().toInstant().toString()
            ]

            outputList << row
        }

        outputStream.write(JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson(outputList)).getBytes("UTF-8"))
    } as StreamCallback)

    flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, "record.count", "generated")

    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

} catch (Exception e) {
    log.error("Error parsing ADSB JSON", e)
    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_FAILURE)
}
